content: On January 17, 2024, a corrigendum was issued for the second edition of the Catalogue of Mutations in Mycobacterium tuberculosis Complex and Their Association with Drug Resistance. The electronic version of this publication is identified by ISBN 978-92-4-008241-0, while the print version is identified by ISBN 978-92-4-008242-7. The corrigendum addresses formatting issues in the document, where single letters were inadvertently removed from 148 words at random throughout the text. These errors have now been corrected, and the updated version has been incorporated into the electronic file.
